approach: Add an incremental runner `run_check` in athena-gate attribution.rs on top of the existing `walk`. Incremental mode reads the newest checkpoint (by records-branch first-parent order) under `checkpoints/`, walks only main commits after `main_sha`, and judges only records added since `records_sha` via a new range audit `audit_history_since` in records_branch.rs. It falls back to a full replay with a stated reason when there is no checkpoint, the check version differs, or the checkpoint names a non-ancestor. Full-replay mode ignores checkpoints, judges everything, and adds a CheckpointDisagrees finding if the newest checkpoint names a commit the replay fails or that is off main. A pass with writing enabled and no pending commit writes a Checkpoint record via the records writer. The CLI adds `--full-replay` and `--no-checkpoint` to `check --attribution`, treats env CI as read-only, checkpoints after a landed `athena land`, and prints seconds, commits judged and records judged. CI runs the incremental check on push and `--full-replay` on schedule, with the token read-only. Timing comes from a ~200-landing synthetic fixture test that prints both numbers.

decisions.choice: Put mode logic, checkpoint read/write and counters in one `run_check` in athena-gate, reusing `walk` with a start commit and records-delta parameter; the CLI is a thin caller.
decisions.reason: Testable with the gate testutil without a binary or the host; one rule for judging.

rejected.why: Only testable through the binary, and land needs a real gh.

rejected.option: A second walker for incremental mode

decisions.choice: Newest checkpoint = the one added by the newest first-parent records commit touching `checkpoints/`.
decisions.reason: Records-branch order cannot be forged via ids or created_at.

decisions.choice: Incremental records judged = files added between records_sha and tip; widen to all records once if a new commit has no named landing in the delta.
decisions.reason: Keeps soundness while the common case has counts equal to new records.

decisions.choice: No checkpoint on findings, pending commits, or read-only (`--no-checkpoint` or env CI non-empty). Workflow keeps `contents: read`.
decisions.reason: CI read-only is enforced by both token and code.

rejected.why: A failed push is not a mechanism.

decisions.choice: Write checkpoint with append_to_remote("origin") when origin exists, local append otherwise; verifier_version is CHECK_VERSION, overridable via Options.
decisions.reason: CI reads the fetched remote branch.

decisions.choice: Print stats from main.rs (text line and JSON keys); do not edit display.rs.
decisions.reason: display.rs is not a listed deliverable.

decisions.choice: For land, a main.rs helper runs run_check incrementally with writing on after LinkState::Landed, skipped under CI; unit-tested directly.

In attribution.rs add CHECK_VERSION, Mode, Options, RunReport and run_check; extend walk with optional start commit and records delta; add checkpoint reader/writer and full-replay disagreement check.
Write the gate tests: incremental counts, tampered checkpoint, version change, failing/pending writes nothing, checkpoint contents, full-replay and read-only, and the 200-landing timing test.
In main.rs add flags with clap conflicts, CI read-only, stats output in text and JSON, exit codes, and the post-landing helper wired into Command::Land with a unit test.

risks.risk: Incremental judging passes something a full replay fails.
risks.mitigation: Widen to all records when a new commit has no named landing in the delta; weekly and version-change full replays bound trust; a test compares verdicts.

risks.risk: Concurrent writer moves records tip before the checkpoint write.
risks.mitigation: records_sha is the tip judged against; later records are judged next run.

risks.risk: 200-landing fixture is slow because each record is a git commit.
risks.mitigation: Use existing helpers, one commit per landing; check runtime and keep in normal cargo test.
Print labelled figures; assert counts only.

risks.risk: Forged checkpoint naming a good-looking commit is trusted incrementally.
risks.mitigation: Accepted bound in §9; weekly full replay compares against the newest checkpoint.

demonstrations.method: Fixture with 3 attributed landings, passing run writes a checkpoint, add 2 landings, run again.
demonstrations.observes: Second run is incremental; commits judged is 2 and records judged equals the files the 2 landings added, lower than a full replay.
demonstrations.fails_without: A run ignoring the checkpoint reports all commits and records, so the equality assertion on new-only counts fails.

demonstrations.method: Hand-write a checkpoint naming a commit the replay fails; run full replay in gate and via binary.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-gate attribution::tests::tampered_checkpoint_is_caught_by_full_replay && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test binary full_replay_tampered_checkpoint_exits_2
demonstrations.observes: CheckpointDisagrees finding, passed() false, exit status 2.
demonstrations.fails_without: A replay that trusted the checkpoint would pass or skip the bad commit, so no finding and exit 0.

demonstrations.method: Checkpoint with version A, run with Options version B.
demonstrations.observes: Full replay, counts equal whole history, reason text names both versions and a check-version change.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the version comparison the run stays incremental with low counts and no reason.

demonstrations.method: Fixtures with an unattributed commit and with a pending commit, writing enabled.
demonstrations.observes: Report fails, checkpoint_written is None, resolve_tip identical before and after.
demonstrations.fails_without: A writer not gated on passed() would move the records tip and the sha-equality assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Gate test, CLI helper test for the land path, and a binary test of check --attribution.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-gate attribution::tests::passing_check_writes_checkpoint && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli checkpoint_after_landing && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test binary check_attribution_writes_checkpoint
demonstrations.observes: Parsed Checkpoint has last passing main sha, records_sha equal to tip judged against, and CHECK_VERSION; tip advanced by one commit.
demonstrations.fails_without: No checkpoint record would exist after a pass, so reading it fails.

demonstrations.method: Valid checkpoint present; full replay vs fresh counts; read-only and CI=true runs.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-gate attribution::tests::full_replay_ignores_checkpoints_and_read_only_never_writes && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test binary check_attribution_in_ci_writes_nothing
demonstrations.observes: Replay counts equal whole history; records tip unchanged in read-only cases.
demonstrations.fails_without: A replay using the checkpoint shows lower counts; a writer ignoring read-only moves the tip.

demonstrations.method: Run the binary on a fixture in text and --json.
demonstrations.observes: Output has mode, seconds, 'commits judged' and 'records judged' with expected numbers; JSON has matching keys.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the reporting line the output assertions on seconds, commits judged and records judged fail.

demonstrations.method: Generate 200 landings, time full replay, write checkpoint, add 1 landing, time incremental; print both.
demonstrations.observes: stdout 'measured on the synthetic 200-landing fixture: full replay X s (N commits, M records); incremental Y s (1 commit, 2 records)'; asserts counts only, never seconds.
demonstrations.fails_without: If incremental mode re-judged everything, the asserted incremental counts (1 commit, 2 records) would fail; if the printout were missing, the test would not emit the labelled figures and the output check fails.

demonstrations.observes: Top-level permissions contents: read unchanged, no contents: write; push runs `athena check --attribution`, schedule runs `athena check --attribution --full-replay`.

Entry describes checkpoint, incremental, full-replay and CI behaviour, quotes fixture timings labelled as measured on the synthetic fixture, and states timing on this repository is taken after landing.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks together.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0 across the workspace.
demonstrations.fails_without: A formatting difference, any clippy warning (denied), or any failing test in the workspace, including the new tests above, makes the command exit non-zero.
